assertions.assertion: The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)

The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management
consistent with the supported diagnosis codes I48.91, I34.0, and I49.5
